change: Replace the mismatched generic triangle-area renderer with a dedicated right-triangular-prism surface-area/volume learning model.

interactionContract.initialPrediction: 3-4-5 right-triangle base; prism length 4 cm to 6 cm; answer/formula remains locked until correct submission.
interactionContract.incorrectAttempt: First wrong answer receives a conceptual hint (perimeter controls side-area increase; base area controls volume increase); worked model stays locked for retry.
interactionContract.unlockedModel: Solid prism, two triangular end faces and three rectangular net faces, per-face table, accessible length slider, linked surface area and volume, four reasoning steps.
interactionContract.reset: Clears choices and returns to locked prediction state.
interactionContract.keyboard: Choice, submit, step navigation, and slider updates preserve focus.
